description: Aeon deny-by-default runtime containment policy. Uses relative-root templates (not machine-specific paths). Enforced by aeon/runtime_policy.py; verified by tests/test_runtime_policy.py.

execution_identity.notes: The runtime environment (systemd unit, container, wrapper) enforces this. Aeon-side verifiers check code invariants only; OS enforcement is the deployment's responsibility.

filesystem_policy.notes: aeon.runtime_policy.check_path() applies these rules; committed policy MUST NOT contain absolute machine paths.

network_policy.notes: Certified local mode: zero required network use for training, resume, validation, diagnostics, generation, recovery. Verified by tests/test_runtime_policy.py::test_no_network_client_in_forward_path.

process_policy.notes: Aeon's runtime does not have model-directed authority for any of the above. Aeon-side verifiers scan the code base to prove absence; OS containment (e.g. seccomp, AppArmor) is the deployment's responsibility to add on top.

resource_controls.notes: Resource exhaustion enters SAFE_HALT (§F5) rather than consume the host.
